data.topic: Is road infrastructure investment in China excessive? Evidence from productivity of firms
data.speaker: 黎志刚
data.abstract: China's road investment boom since 1990 has often been criticized as excessive due to the distortions of government incentives. To address this concern, we provide econometric evidence on the productivity of road investment in China using panel data of medium and large manufacturers nationwide during 1998-2007. We extend the model of Fernald (1999) to allow for imperfect competition. To address endogeneity in road investment, we estimate the differential impact of road investment on the productivity growth of firms with different transport reliance. Our estimates suggest a rate of return of approximately 83%, which is large enough to reject the excessiveness of road infrastructure in China during the sample period. Moreover, contrary to common criticism, we find that the productivity of roads is higher in inland China, where institutional quality is lower.

data.abstract: 事件相关光学脑成像技术 (Event-Related Optical Signals, EROS) 研讨会通知近年来 , 光学成像技术蓬勃发展 , 成为认知神经科学领域中一项重要的研究手段。光学成像技术可在不同层次揭示神经系统的结构和功能信息 , 从新的角度为解释认知活动提供重要的实验依据。光成像 (Optical Imaging) 的基本原理是神经元活动会引起某些物质 ( 如水、离子 ) 的改变 , 导致神经无光学的特性发生变化 , 这些变化在与外加的、某些特定波长的光量子相互作用后,可得到了相应的光信号。

data.title: 12月4日蔡清副教授、库逸轩副教授学术讲座--心理系建系三十周年暨建院三周年系列学术活动
data.topic: Neural mechanisms underlying working memory representations and processes (工作记忆表征和加工的神经机制)
data.speaker: 库逸轩
data.speakerAffiliation: 华东师范大学认知神经科学研究所
data.listTitle: 12月4日蔡清副教授、库逸轩副教授学术讲座--心理系建系三十周年暨建院三周年系列学术活动
data.abstract: The left hemisphere (LH) dominance for language is one of the most important lateralized phenomena in human brain. Its origin and mechanisms, however, are still far from clear. Although most people have LH language dominance, in evolutionary perspective, individual variation is not simply deviations but a critical element of 'survival'. We therefore looked into healthy adults with atypical right hemispheric dominance for speech production, to further investigate the neural mechanisms of lateralized language production and their interaction with other cognitive functions. We are interested in knowing to what extent the frontal language dominance have influences on other language-related functions such as reading, and non-language cognitive functions such as visuo-spatial attention. I will show our recent studies examining to what extent sensory input underlies the side of language dominance in patients with congenital right ear deafness. Further more, gross asymmetry in anatomy is surprisingly only subtly related to functional asymmetry in language. I will also provide an update on our recent studies using graph theory based methods examining resting-state networks in adults with (a) typical language dominance.
data.speakerBio: 清华大学学士、博士,之后分别在华东师范大学心理与认知科学学院(2010--2012年)、美国加州大学旧金山分校神经内科系(2013—2015年)进行博士后研究。主要研究人类记忆与注意的认知加工过程及其神经机制,采用多种神经成像方法和计算模型进行研究,并将试图将这些机制应用于不同的特殊群体上,如老年人、精神分裂症患者、自闭症谱系障碍儿童等。研究成果发表在Brain Stimulation、European Journal of Neuroscience、Journal of Neurophysiology、Neurobiology of Aging等多个期刊,担任国家自然科学基金项目、国家973项目等多个项目负责人。

data.speakerBio: 上海交大生物技术学士,法国里昂大学认知科学博士。在法国国家科学研究中心语言-大脑-认知实验室(L2C2,CNRS)完成硕博学习,之后在比利时根特大学实验心理学系和法国国家健康中心Neurospin实验室进行博士后研究。主要通过功能性核磁共振(fMRI),事件相关脑电波(ERP)等方法结合行为实验,研究(1)健康被试大脑的功能侧化,结构偏侧,静息态和任务态下的同步低频震荡(Low frequency fluctuations)以及它们之间的相关性,(2)视觉词汇认知,动词加工,语音加工等语言功能之间,以及它们与视觉空间频率信息处理,视觉空间注意机制,数字处理,认知决策等非语言认知功能之间的相关性,(3)儿童发展中的数学和语言学习,特别是它们 "再利用" 相关脑区其他非人类特有认知能力的功能网络的发展机制。

data.topic: 人类公平行为的神经机制:社会情景的调节作用
data.speaker: 封春亮
data.speakerAffiliation: 北京师范大学脑与认知科学研究院
data.listTitle: 第65期心理沙龙-封春亮博士-心理系建系三十周年暨建院三周年系列学术活动
data.abstract: 人们在决策过程中经常会偏离"绝对理性"的决定,而表现出对社会准则的偏好。例如,人们经常会基于对公平的考量而宁愿牺牲掉自己一部分经济利益。这种对社会准则的偏好近年来受到经济学与心理学等各个领域研究者的广泛关注。近年来,脑成像的研究也进一步加深了对人类公平行为的理解。在这个报告中,我将介绍与人类公平行为相关的重要脑区,以及它们在公平决策中所起的作用。此外,我将着重介绍社会情景如何影响人们的公平行为及其相关的神经机制;以及,人们如何以自利偏向(self-serving bias)的方式来解释社会情景,从而让自己在公平决策中间接地获利。
data.speakerBio: 封春亮,北京师范大学脑与认知科学研究院、认知神经科学与学习国家重点实验室博士,曾留学美国Emory大学,已在Human Brain Mapping、Social Cognitive and Affective Neuroscience等国际英文学术期刊发表论文20余篇(其中第一作者12篇、通讯作者3篇),主要研究兴趣包括神经调质(如oxytocin, vasopressin)对人类社会行为调节的神经机制、社会情景对人类社会决策与共情影响的神经机制等。

data.speaker: 周晓祺
data.speakerAffiliation: 中山大学物理与科学技术学院
data.listTitle: [讲座]优化线性光学量子信息处理中的软件与硬件
data.abstract: 光子系统具有抗退相干、易于编码、易于操控等优点,是量子信息载体的首选系统之一。虽然使用光子为载体的量子信息处理具有以上的优点,但它同时也存在着一些弱点,阻碍了光学量子信息处理技术的实用化。我们从软件和硬件两方面提出了一些优化线性光学量子信息处理的方案,并在实验上验证了这些方案,从而推动了线性光学量子信息技术的发展。 简介: 2003. 09 – 2008. 07 中国科学技术大学博士 ( 师从潘建伟院士) 2008. 11 - 2015. 06 英国 (University of Bristol),博士后 2015. 06 中山大学理工学院,教授一直从事线性光学量子信息研究,累计发表论文19篇,其中Sciene 1篇,Nature Photonics 2篇,Nature Physics 1篇,Nature Communications 2篇,PNAS 1篇,Physical Review Letters 4篇,Optica 2篇,文章引用次数>900 。 主要研究工作包括 : (1) 实现多比特量子门的新方法及其实验验证; (2) 量子相位估计算法的完美实现; (3) 突破散粒噪声极限的量子过程层析; (4) 集成光学量子芯片的研制及其应用; (5) 多光子纠缠态的制备及其应用。

data.topic: The cognitive neural basis of object knowledge ( 客体知识在大脑认知神经机制)
data.speaker: 毕彦超
data.listTitle: 毕彦超教授学术讲座--心理系建系三十周年暨建院三周年系列学术活动
data.abstract: Conceptual knowledge serves as a foundation for various cognitive processes including language, object recognition and use, reasoning, and problem solving. How is conceptual knowledge represented in the brain? I will present a series of experiments in my lab that explored this issue, focusing on object concepts in relation to objects' shape and motion knowledge. We used a convergent of approaches including brain imaging studies with healthy, blind, and brain-damaged individuals. The overall results indicate a distributed representation of object conceptual knowledge across various modality-specific sensory-motor systems, which are bound functionally and anatomically by complex connections.

data.title: 中国人民大学刘勇政副教授讲座暨157期“华南经济论坛”通知
data.topic: Fiscal Reform, Land Expansion, and Urban Growth in China
data.speaker: 刘勇政
data.abstract: The central government of the People's Republic of China enacted a fiscal reform known as the "Province-Managing-County" (PMC) reform in the early 2000s. This reform eliminated the prefecture city government as the intermediate layer between the province and the county. We apply a difference-in-difference method using a panel data set of 263 cities nationwide over the period of 1999-2011 to examine how the introduction of the PMC reform affects the economic growth of the cities. Our results show that on average implementing the PMC reform moderately increases city growth by 0.8 percent. We argue that this unexpected positive growth effect of the reform is induced by the expansion of land supply of the reformed cities, which in the post-reform period have faced the need to look for revenues outside the budget system, mainly extra-budgetary funds in the form of leasing land. Our analysis provides evidence on this argument, and reveals that the reformed cities tend to expand land leasing at a speed that is 14 percent higher than the non-reformed cities. Furthermore, we show that the impacts of the reform tend to be strengthened over time following the introduction of the reform. Our results are quite robust across several robustness checks.

data.topic: Bilingual Processes of Text Comprehension: An event-related potentials (ERPs) investigation (双语者在文本阅读过程中的机制:来自 ERP 实验的研究)
data.speaker: 杨金龙
data.listTitle: 第64期心理沙龙-杨金龙博士-心理系建系三十周年暨建院三周年系列学术活动
data.abstract: Psycholinguistic studies that examine the effect of bilingual proficiency have largely focused on the lexical, semantic and syntactic processing whereas those at the text level have received relatively little attention (Tokowicz & Perfetti, 2005). We conducted an event-related potential (EPR) study to examine the proficiency effect on the bilingual (L2) processes of the three levels of text representation (i.e., lexical/conceptual (textbase)/situational, Kintsch, 1998) during the real-time processes of L2 text comprehension. Four-eight English as the second language learners (L2/ESL: high vs. low proficiency, 24 each), read two-sentences passages in English where the "referent-matching" relation of the target word ("The explosion.."), to the text matches with the three levels of text representation: A surface-level match as in "…exploded... The explosion…"; a textbase match as in "…blew up... The explosion…"; and a situation-model match as in "…bomb…dropped. The explosion…". Additionally, a non-sensible baseline "…bomb was stored safely… The explosion…" was used to compare the ease of integration processing among conditions. We analyzed the N400 (250-500ms post-target onset) and late positivity component (LPC, 500-700ms) to assess the proficiency effect on the semantic integration (Kutas & Hillyard, 1980) and the mental-model construction processes (Burkhardt, 2007; Brouwer, et al., 2012) respectively. The results indicate robust proficiency effect when processing textbase match: the amplitude of both N400 and LPC was reduced for high-proficient L2/ESL while enhanced for low-proficient L2/ESL. No reliable proficiency effect was observed when integrating the target word with the text relied on a surface-match and a demanding conceptual processing (i.e., inference-drawing when processing the situation match): both groups showed reduced N400 while enhanced LPC effect. The results, overall, underline the importance of the L2 semantic/conceptual processing in modulating the ease of both meaning integration and mental-model construction processes during L2 text comprehension; and also suggest the high resource constraints in bilinguals' mental-model construction processes due to their non-native lexico-semantic processing (as compared to monolinguals, Burkhardt, 2007; Yang, et al., 2007).
data.speakerBio: 杨金龙教授,于 2000 年在美国北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校获得心理学博士学位,曾先后在美国莱斯大学,卡耐基梅龙大学,匹兹堡大学,香港大学,香港城市大学从事研究和教学工作。现为香港中文大学语言学系荣誉助理教授。杨金龙教授的研究方向为:阅读与语言的认知与神经机制,高层次语言加工的认知机制,双语学习的认知机制。杨教授主持多项香港重要的科研基金项目,目前已经在 Cognition, JEP.LMC 等国际权威期刊发表论文近 20 篇,参编 6 本学术著作。

data.topic: Intergenerational Income Mobility, Liquidity Constraint and Household Saving
data.speaker: 徐舒
data.abstract: This paper studies the impact of intergenerational income mobility on household saving behaviour in urban China. We develop a simple static model and demonstrate that altruistic parents will save more when intergenerational elasticity of income (IGE) is smaller. Comparative static analysis shows that the magnitude of IGE on household saving is amplified by liquidity constraint, as well as other interesting theoretical predictions.Empirical results using CHIPS data are consistent with our model's various predictions. Our estimate indicates that a 1% decrease in IGE is associated with a 0.126%-0.196% increase in household saving rate. As a result, the decreasing IGE in our sample period will lead to a 2.6 - 3.4 percentage point increase in household saving rate, which accounts for 14%-19% of the total increase of Chinese urban household saving rate.

data.abstract: 近年来中国人力资源服务业得到了前所未有的迅猛发展,人才职业发展服务、人才规划服务、人才测评服务、人才招聘和配置服务、人才绩效管理服务、人才薪酬福利管理服务、人才培训服务、人才派遣服务、电子化人才信息技术服务、人力资源业务合作伙伴服务等业态逐步呈现并日益成熟。在国家产业转型升级、"一带一路"、"中国制造2025"和人才强国战略的背景下,中国人力资源服务业迎来历史性机遇,同时面临严峻的挑战和发展瓶颈,急需转型升级。新一代信息技术的应用给中国人力资源服务业的转型升级提供了契机和解决方案。虽然目前理论研究远远落后于实践,但是人才服务学研究已经悄然出现,并迫在眉睫。围绕着人才、人才观、人才服务业态、人才服务机构、人才服务人才培养、人才服务学学科体系和专业建设及相应的研究方法等领域和问题,需要来自多个学科的学者们以及人力资源服务业实践界同仁的产学研合作研究,以求真正揭示人才服务的规律。
data.speakerBio: 陈国海博士:本科和硕士毕业于厦门大学,香港大学心理学博士;广东省人力资源研究会副会长兼秘书长;美国人力资源管理学会和国际幽默学会会员;广东金融学院客座教授。主要研究兴趣包括幽默心理学、人力资源管理与服务、企业教练技术、组织行为与员工培训。主持广东省自然科学基金等多项省部级纵向课题;政府和企业委托的横向课题10余项。广东省精品资源共享课程《组织行为学》主持人、广东省精品教材《组织行为学》主编。出版《组织行为学》等教材10余部,出版《人才服务学》、《幽默教学》、《中国企业教练技术》等专著10余部,并在HUMOR、Social Indicators Research、Assessment & Evaluation in Higher Education等国内外杂志上发表了87篇学术论文。其中,第一作者发表10余篇SSCI检索的国际期刊论文。

data.title: [讲座]Pion-Nucleon Scattering within Covariant Baryon Chiral
data.topic: Pion-Nucleon Scattering within Covariant Baryon Chiral Perturbation Theory
data.speaker: 陈云华
data.listTitle: [讲座]Pion-Nucleon Scattering within Covariant Baryon Chiral
data.abstract: Pion-nucleon scattering is an important process for the understanding of chiral QCD dynamics and strong interactions. In this talk, I will show our result of the analytic and complete pion-nucleon scattering amplitudes up to O(p^4), and regularize it in the extended-on-mass-shell scheme which faithfully respects analyticity. Numerical fits to partial wave phase shift data are performed to pin down the free low energy constants, and a good convergence for the chiral series at O(p^4) is achieved. Based on the amplitudes, a phenomenological discussion is made on the pion-nucleon sigma term, which is the main source of uncertainty in the interpretation of direct searches of supersymmetric dark matter.

data.listTitle: 陈善广研究员学术报告--心理系建系三十周年暨建院三周年系列学术活动
data.abstract: 简介: 载人航天,以人为本。航天人因工程是人因工程学在载人航天领域中的应用,秉承"为航天员使用而设计"的理念,分析研究航天特因环境下航天员生理、心理等能力特性及其变化规律,从系统层面研究解决航天员("人")、航天器("机")和航天环境("环")之间的关系问题,确保航天员在轨安全、舒适、高效工作,实现系统优化整合。航天人因工程从载人航天计划启动之初就得到美俄等航天大国的高度重视,各国逐步制定了航天人的因素发展计划。从失重环境下人的运动操作能力变化到空间飞行中人的认知决策特性规律研究,从航天器人机界面等的"适人性"设计到人员选拔训练的"人适应机与环"的方法学突破,从航天员和航天器/航天服之间交互方式、人机功能分配关键科学问题研究到航天器研制全周期过程管理中人系统整合设计与评估技术的持续发展与应用,航天人因工程在国际载人航天舞台上发挥着越来越重要的作用并在航天飞行实践中不断丰富发展。 面向未来,长期空间飞行特别是载人深空探测对人类挑战巨大,重力变化、隔离密闭、昼夜节律变化、辐射等环境会使人的生理机能、认知、情绪等发生改变,航天员完成任务风险增加,这也对航天人因工程提出了更高要求。同时,新技术的突破也将为未来载人航天任务提供更先进高效的探测手段和工具,将促进新型人机交互方式的发展,如人与智能机器人联合探测模式的发展与成熟。本文从航天人因工程概念和作用出发,系统总结了国内外航天人因工程研究进展和发展趋势,分析并给出了我国航天人因工程面向空间站、载人登月和深空探测任务需求的发展重点和技术途径。
data.speakerBio: 博士,研究员,博士生导师,主要从事人机环境工程方向研究。现任中国载人航天工程副总设计师;人因工程重点实验室主任;国际宇航科学院院士;中国空间学会副理事长、空间生命科学专业委员会主任委员;中国宇航学会航天医学工程和空间生物学专委会主任委员;全军武器装备人-机-环标准化委员会主任委员、总装空间生命保障工程学科责任专家;国家973重大基础专项首席科学家。 1982 年毕业于武汉大学,一直从事国防科技和航天事业,我国载人航天领域航天医学工程学科带头人。1992年起参与国家载人航天工程全过程研制,历任中国航天员科研训练中心主任、中国载人航天工程航天员系统副总设计师、总设计师、总指挥,全面负责神州六号至神州九号任务航天员系统与环控生保分系统研制工作,为我国载人航天工程的实施作出突出贡献。 获得国家科技进步特等奖1项、一等奖1项,军队(含国防科工委)科技进步一等奖7项、二等奖10项、三等奖3项;出版专著5部,译著3部,发表论文70余篇,获发明专利11项;指导培养博士、硕士研究生20余名。1995年当选全国青年联合会员,首批入选国家"百千万人才工程"第一、二层次,1998年享受政府特殊津贴,2004年获国家载人航天突出贡献奖章、中国科协"求是"杰出青年实用工程奖,2006年获曾宪梓航天基金奖,科学中国人(2007/2008)年度人物。首批进入全军领军人才工程,2012年获军队杰出专业技术人才奖。

data.title: 第62期心理沙龙
data.topic: Money and Relationships: When and Why Thinking about Money Leads People to Approach Others (金钱和人际关系再探:金钱对人际归属的促进作用)
data.speaker: 滕飞
data.listTitle: 第62期心理沙龙
data.abstract: Monetary reminders have been shown to refrain people from affiliating with others. We proposed such an effect can be reserved when others are instrumental to people's goal pursuit. Four experiments converged to support our proposition. We found that thinking about money increases people's focus on the instrumentality aspects of others (Experiment 1). More importantly, in a goal pursuit context, monetary reminders increase people's tendency to approach others who are instrumental for achieving their goals (Experiments 2). The effect of money prime on approaching others was removed when people are highly competent in achieving the goal themselves (Experiment 3), and when the goal is ambiguous (Experiment 4). These effects were fully mediated by the perceived instrumentality of others (Experiments 2-4). Our findings suggest that thinking about money leads to an instrumentality orientation in social interaction, which changes how people view relationships and how they interact with others.

data.title: 夏威夷大学郑东萍博士学术讲座
data.topic: An ecological, dialogical and distributed perspective on cognition and language learning
data.speaker: 郑东萍
data.listTitle: 夏威夷大学郑东萍博士学术讲座
data.abstract: From an ecological, dialogical and distributed (EDD) perspective, cognition and learning learning are embodied, situated, dynamic and values-realizing. In tracing the development of EDD views applied to second language (L2) learning with technologies that afford avatar embodiment and place-based interactivity, this talk promotes an action-oriented sociocultural orientation to cognition and L2 learning, i.e., as it takes place in the dynamics of play in massively multiplayer online games (MMOG), such as World of Warcraft (WoW), and multi-user virtual environments, such as Second Life or Active Worlds, as well in the ecological and sociocultural spaces. Research taking an EDD view of language has investigated the educational potentials of multiplayer online environments, highlighting them in a way that a classical cogntive lens could not. This is in part due to the EDD view that human values play a central role in language and cognition, grounding all aspects of perceiving and action that involve intra- and inter-bodily movements. The talk centers on the following questions: 1) how do studies of L2 learning with games and virtual environments treat contexts: as input vs. as sites with affordances for a range of action potentials; 2) what is the unit of analysis: individual perception vs. perception and action cycles or turn-by-turn utterances vs. co-acted communicative projects; 3) how is language theorized: language is a code vs. differentiation between real-time languaging (accounting for both language and actions) and prescriptive lexicogrammars and discourse-semantic regularities; 4) how is interactivity analyzed: using transcription of utterances or text chat vs. using transcriptions of language and actions from dynamic multimodal texts.
data.speakerBio: 郑东萍教授于 2006 年获得 University of Connecticut 教育心理学博士。现任 University of Hawaii, The Department of Second Language Studies 副教授。主要研究应用生态心理学, 对话学,分布认知及语言来扩张以人为中心的传统二语习得理论。 具体课题研究包括虚拟游戏空间环境对语言认知的影响,和以移动无限通讯技术为平台的游戏设计对扩展认知与学习空间,以及社会文化参与于认知的潜能。

data.topic: Familiarity breeds investment if you have the right gene: A gene-brain-behavior study of familiarity bias in financial decision making
data.speaker: 周恕弘
data.listTitle: 新加坡国立大学周恕弘教授讲座暨第145期“华南经济论坛”
data.abstract: In his 1921 Treatise on Probability, John Maynard Keynes offered a striking hypothesis about decision making under uncertainty: "... if two probabilities are equal in degree, ought we, in choosing our course of action, to prefer that one which is based on a greater body of knowledge?" This hypothesis has led to two significant strands of thinking in the literature on decision making under uncertainty - ambiguity aversion, discussed in Daniel Ellsberg's seminal paper in 1961, and a preference for betting on the more familiar, articulated in several papers by Amos Tversky and his coauthors in the 90's. The latter papers further suggest that familiarity bias may underpin the equity home bias puzzle, first documented by Feldsteina and Horioka (1980) and French and Poterba (1991) and corroborated in the works of Huberman (2001) and Coval and Moskowitz (2002) providing evidence of a domestic home market bias. This talk will discuss findings from several experimental studies related to familiarity bias including one using molecular genetics and neuroimaging to establish a gene-brain-behavior link for a decision making disposition which may influence behavior at the level of the market.
data.speakerBio: 周恕弘(Chew Soo Hong),新加坡国立大学讲席教授,国际经济计量学会的院士/会士(Fellow)。周恕弘教授是世界著名的决策理论和实验经济学家,曾执教于美国亚利桑那大学、约翰霍普金斯大学,加州大学尔湾分校,香港科技大学(担任讲座教授)。在Econometrica,Journal of Economic Theory等世界顶级学术期刊上发表大量论文。2011年他当选为国际经济计量学会(Econometric Society)的会士(Fellow),是这一世界上最著名的经济学协会自1933年创建以来的第11位华人会士。

data.speakerBio: 陈功博士,宾夕法尼亚州立大学生物学系Verne M. Willaman 冠名教授,华南师范大学特聘教授。早年毕业于复旦大学,随后师从中国科学院上海生理研究所冯德培院士攻读博士学位。博士毕业后先后在耶鲁大学、斯坦福大学进行博士后研究。研究兴趣主要集中于"突触发生与可塑性"和"神经干细胞研究"等方面。其研究成果对神经发育、学习记忆机制、神经损伤后的修复有重大影响。近年与美国科学院院士F. Gage合作在世界上首次建立病人干细胞Rett综合征(发表于Cell杂志)及精神分裂症(发表于Nature杂志)模型,并系统地揭示了胶质细胞在促进干细胞神经元分化中的重要作用。其实验室成功建立了在体诱导胶质细胞转化为功能性神经元技术,在一系列由脑神经元死亡引起的神经系统疾病(如老年痴呆症,帕金森氏病及脑中风等)中潜在应用前景广泛。已主持多项美国国家自然科学基金、NIH基金项目和国际会议,先后在Cell,Nature,Nature Neuroscience, Nature Protocols,Neuron,PNAS等世界顶尖杂志发表50余篇高水平论文,获得美国国家研究服务奖(National Research Service Award)、Ohse奖(Ohse Award)、Zenith Fellows Award( Alzheimer's Association)等多项奖励。多家新闻机构(包括人民日报)系统报导了陈功教授的多项干细胞成果。 更多信息见 http://bio.psu.edu/directory/guc2

data.topic: 如何成为一名优秀的心理健康老师
data.speaker: 李绮萍
data.speakerAffiliation: 佛山市中小学心理健康指导中心办公室主任,中学心理
data.listTitle: 广东省“劳动模范” 校友李绮萍老师讲座
data.abstract: 作为全国优秀教师,中学心理高级教师, 李绮萍老师在中小学生心理健康教育辅导,教材编写,课程设置以及学术研究方面具有着丰富的经验。此次讲座,李老师将会在自己 20 多年从教经验的背景下,对心理学院研究生毕业班以及本科生三年级学生,就如何成为一名优秀的心理健康老师给出相应的建议和指导。
data.speakerBio: 李绮萍, 1991 — 1995 年就读于华南师范大学心理系本科、教育硕士。现任广东省中小学心理健康教育委员会委员会、佛山市中小学心理健康指导中心办公室主任,中学心理高级教师。 荣获 2015 年"广东省劳动模范"荣誉称号。 二十年来,李绮萍老师以专业知识耕耘心灵交流之道,对佛山市中小学的突发性心理危机事件的处理起到了良好的示范作用。 作为广东省开设心理必修课第一人,她创造性地编写了佛山一中心理健康教育校本教材。同时,李绮萍老师倾注心血于心理课程的教学研究,针对中学生心理特点及学校的实际,她紧扣学生的心理需求,积极探索出有学校特色的心理健康教育,提炼形成了"活动——体验——感悟——践行"的体验型心理活动课模式。这种模式得到同行的高度评价与推广,在全省乃至全国具有广泛影响力。李绮萍老师在中学心理教育方面工作卓有成效,先后参与或主持的省级以上科研项目多项、出版著作及发表文章多篇,荣获 2014 年教育部授予的"全国优秀教师"荣誉称号以及省级以上教育行政部门奖励的科研成果多项。

data.abstract: 介绍磁共振研究的进展及课题组的实验开展情况。 翁旭初教授简介: 1985 年本科毕业于浙江中医学院; 1985-1989 在浙江省慈溪人民医院从事临床工作; 1992 年和 1995 年在中科院心理所分别获得硕士和博士学位; 1997 年、 1999 年分别晋升副研究员和研究员; 2010 年调动到杭州师范大学,并与同事们一起建立了杭州师范大学认知与脑疾病研究中心。 1995 年开始利用 fMRI 技术研究人脑功能, 1996 年建立我国首家 fMRI 专业实验室; 1998 年在国际上率先报告汉字加工的 fMRI 研究;随后发现小脑参与复杂运动的准备和语言意义辨别等高级认知功能,并在文字加工和神经、精神疾病研究中取得一定成就。目前主要研究领域包括:文字特别是汉字加工的神经基础,主要关注左侧梭状回对文字加工的特异性和可塑性;应用脑成像技术研究抑郁症等神经、精神疾病的神经基础。

data.title: 第138期“华南经济论坛”通知
data.topic: Deal or No Deal? The Effect of Alcohol Drinking on Bargaining
data.speaker: 张吉鹏
data.speakerBio: 张吉鹏毕业于美国匹兹堡大学经济系,现为西南财经大学经济与管理学院副教授。他的主要研究方向为公共经济学、产业组织、中国经济、行为经济学和实验经济学。他在 International Economic Review, International Journal of Industrial, Organization, Journal of Real Estate Literature等英文期刊上发表论文多篇。他硕士期间与复旦大学经济学院的张军教授等合作的论文《中国省际物质资本存量估算:1952—2000》是引用次数最多的中文经济学论文之一。
data.abstract: Alcohol drinking during business negotiation is a very common practice, particularly in some East Asian countries. Does alcohol consumption affect negotiator's strategy and consequently the outcome of the negotiation? If so, what is the mechanism through which alcohol impacts negotiator's behavior? We investigate the effect of a moderate amount of alcohol on negotiation using controlled experiments. Subjects are randomly matched into pairs to play a bargaining game with adverse selection. In the game, each subject is given a private endowment. The total endowment is scaled up and shared equally between the pair provided that they agree to collaborate. It is found that a moderate amount of alcohol consumption increases subjects' willingness to collaborate, thus improving everyone's expected payoff. We find that alcohol increases neither subjects' preference for risk nor altruism. A possible explanation for the increase in the likelihood of trade, and hence the welfare of trading, is that subjects under the influence of alcohol are more "cursed" in the sense of Eyster and Rabin (2005). This explanation was supported by the estimated cursedness parameters from a structural model of quantile response equilibrium.

data.abstract: Human brain matures at different rates across time and different regions, with some areas matured at early adulthood. To foster a better understanding of normal brain maturation as a basis for understanding atypical brain development associated with a variety of disorders and diseases, MRI images of healthy subjects were acquired longitudinally after birth, and then normal cortical structural development is systematically analyzed and modelled. Both methods and results from these data will be discussed in this salon.

data.speaker: 马庆国
data.listTitle: 浙江大学马庆国教授学术讲座
data.abstract: 神经管理学是运用神经科学和其他生命科学技术来研究经济管理问题的国际新兴前沿领域,它主要通过研究人们面对典型经济管理问题时的大脑活动与思维过程,从而以一个全新的视角来审视人类决策行为以及更为一般化的社会行为与人性。主要研究领域包括:决策神经科学、神经经济学、神经营销学,神经社会学,以及其他在诸如金融、工业工程、信息技术使用等方面的应用性研究。
data.speakerBio: 马庆国,浙江大学博士生导师,浙大神经管理学实验室主任,浙大管理学院常务副院长,浙江大学一级教授,提出了神经管理学,利用脑电与核磁等神经科学技术研究经济与管理决策。发表论文 300 余篇, SCI/SSCI/EI 论文 80 篇左右,包括在 Neuroimage 等神经科学专业期刊。从 2008 年起成功主持 4 届神经管理学国际会议,产生一定国际影响力。 曾任长江三峡工程论证专家组成员、国家自然科学基金会管理学科评委、国家人事部博士后流动站评委、国务院学位委员会管理科学组成员、长江特聘教授评委等。现任中国"管理科学与工程学会"常务副理事长、浙大管理科学与工程国家重点学科带头人、浙大信息技术与新兴产业研究中心主任。获得省部以上科学技术与人文科学 2 等奖 6 项, 1 等奖 1 项。省部以上 3 等奖 8 项。国家教学成果奖 1 项。此外,在管理科学与工程学科建设方面,主导起草了"管理科学与工程博士论文评判参考标准",获国家教学成果奖。 神经管理学( NeuroManagement )最早由浙江大学神经管理实验室主任马庆国教授提出。目前马庆国教授的研究主要集中在以下几个领域: 基于神经管理学的非常规突发事件下"氛围－个体－群体"与"生理－心理－行为"多层耦合规律和组合干预研究,国家自然科学基金重大项目,项目负责人; 哲学社会科学方法创新研究; 决策神经科学中关于框架效应、锚定效应、小概率、情绪等的研究; 工人生理和心理状态与生产管理规则的对比研究; 安全生产管理:对生产环境中安全警示标志的神经响应研究。 更多马庆国教授的信息请参见 : http://www.cma.zju.edu.cn/neuromanagementlab/index.php/zh_team.html

data.listTitle: 澳门大学范息涛教授学术讲座
data.abstract: Use and interpretation of effect size in empirical studies have become more important in social and behavioral science research in the last two decades, as this has been advocated as good research practice by professional organizations (e.g., American Psychological Association, or APA). Furthermore, some prominent journals in psychology and education have made it a requirement for reporting effect size in the research findings. However, there is a lack of understanding about the current state of affairs with regard to effect size measures in different analytical contexts. In this talk, the relevance of effect size in empirical studies will be discussed, and effect size measures in different analytical contexts will be illustrated. Finally, some guidelines will be provided in understanding and interpreting effect sizes in empirical studies.

data.abstract:
互联网改变了一切，也改变了信息技术的发展范型。
 IT领域当前热点无疑是云计算和大数据，是互联网企业而非传统的IT企业推动了云计算和大数据的发展。这一现象的意义在于，IT的发展范型发生了改变，“应用驱动创新“成为IT领域创新链上的重要环节。互联网企业IT能力建设的巨大成功，“破除”了“迷信”；硬件技术的飞速发展为新一代IT技术的发展奠定了基础；“安全可靠、自主可控”的国家安全战略的提出和落实对我国IT界而言是挑战更是机遇。以上三波叠加，再加上我国经济社会发展提出了丰富、迫切而又极具特色的信息化应用需求，可以得出结论，当前我国IT界处在充满机遇的窗口期。
 如何利用这个难得的时间窗口实现跨越式发展和弯道超车，不仅需要认真分析和清晰认识现实的创新机遇进行，更需要持续有效的“万众创兴”行动，全面激发创新活力。
 中国计算机学会（CCF）成立于1962年，是中国计算机及相关领域的学术团体，宗旨是为本领域专业人士的学术和职业发展提供服务；推动学术进步和技术成果的应用；进行学术评价，引领学术方向；对在学术和技术方面有突出成就的个人和单位给予认可和表彰。
 欢迎有兴趣的师生前来参加！

data.topic: Propensity Score Methods and Its Application in Social and Medical Research (倾向性得分方法及其在社会科学和医学研究中的应用)
data.speaker: 王晓非
data.speakerAffiliation: 美国杜克大学医学院生物统计和生物信息学系
data.listTitle: 学术讲座
data.abstract: Propensity Score Methods and Its Application in Social and Medical Research Observational (nonrandomized) studies are increasingly being used to evaluate treatment effect in social and medical research. Because of the bias associated with treatment selection and the imbalance of baseline covariates between treatment groups in observational, standard statistical methods may yield biased statistical inference on treatment effect. In this talk, we review statistical methods that have been proposed to address treatment selection bias in social and medical research.These methods include multivariable regression and four propensity score based methods. The propensity score is the probability of treatment assignment conditional on observed baseline characteristics. Under certain assumptions, the propensity score allows one to analyze an observational (nonrandomized) study so that it mimics some features of a randomized controlled trial. Four propensity methods are reviewed,including matching on the propensity score, stratification on the propensity score, inverse probability of treatment weighting using the propensity score, and covariate adjustment using the propensity score . We illustrate these methods with a lung cancer surgery study, in which long term and short term clinical outcomes between two surgical procedures - VATS and Open lobectomy – are compared. In the end, we discuss several new advances in treatment effect estimation with observational studies, including a moment-based empirical likelihood method, which does not require a specification of propensity score model, and the instrumental variables method, which does not require all covariates affecting treatment selection are measured. ( 倾向性得分方法简要说明: 当前,人文社会科学领域中一个重要的方法论突破就在于开始关注如何通过严格的统计技术进行因果推论,因果推论背景下的倾向性得分方法是近年在国外发展起来的重要因果分析方法,是排除背景变量混杂干扰,通过模拟随机抽样,使用抽样调查数据计算干预效果的有效方法。 并提供三篇相关论文参考 。) 农村劳动力外出务工模式与留守儿童省略绩--基于广义倾向得分匹配法的分析_李庆海倾向得分法及其在科技工作者自我效能认知研究中的应用倾向值匹配与因果推论方法论述评_胡安宁 学术讲座

data.title: 第56期心理沙龙
data.topic: 习得的刺激-反应联结调节认知控制的神经基础
data.speaker: 夏天生
data.listTitle: 第56期心理沙龙
data.abstract: 认知控制的动态变化往往采用比例一致效应进行研究,对于这一效应的解释主要有注意调节假说和可能性学习假说。后者暗示了一个重要的理论问题:在习得新的刺激-反应联结后,认知控制系统将如何运行。我们采用Hedge 和Marsh任务,结合比例一致效应探讨这一问题。研究发现正的和反转的Simon效应的反转模式,表明了被试用习得的刺激-反应联结来预期反应,脑成像的结果确认了这一模式,显示了习得的刺激-反应联结与任务定义的刺激-反应联结引起的冲突激活了额顶联结区。

data.title: 学术讲座
data.topic: 认知控制:基本机制和应用(Cognitive control: Basic mechanisms and applications)
data.speaker: Tom Verguts
data.speakerAffiliation: 比利时根特大学实验心理学系
data.listTitle: 学术讲座
data.abstract: In recent years, a great number of theories and findings on cognitive control have been proposed. In this talk, I identify two core themes across this broad body of work. First, cognitive control concerns the (hierarchically higher) control of (lower-level) controllers, such as vision or motor control. Second, the same operation and optimization principles used for training lower-level controllers can be used to train the (hierarchically higher) cognitive control system also. I will illustrate several recent applications of these two principles with studies from my and other research groups.
data.speakerBio: Prof. Dr. Tom Verguts , 于比利时鲁汶大学获得博士学位,后在比利时根特大学实验心理学系任教多年,现为该系正教授。其当前研究兴趣主要集中在:心理学计算模型和认知控制。其已在国际心理学和神经科学学术期刊上发表论文 100 多篇。

data.abstract: 以往研究发现，在传统网络媒体如广告视频门户网站中，正性信息得到更多的点击和分享转发，但是在web3.0时代，网络社交平台中负性信息却常常得到大量转发。本研究探讨了微博平台中情绪信息的效价对传播的影响及其神经机制。

data.abstract: Neurodegenerative disorders are posing a larger amount of challenge to public health burden than ever. A set of electrophysiological markers of attentional processes, semantic processing, and verbal memory have been extensively tested for several neurodegenerative diseases including fragile X-associated tremor/ataxia syndrome (FXTAS), Alzheimer's Disease (AD), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and Parkinson's Disease (PD). In this presentation, electrophysiological, neurological testing, and/or genetic findings regarding cognitive deficits as well as treatment effects from a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial will be reviewed. Overall, the results demonstrated that well-designed cognitive ERP/EEG tests can offer sensitive means to detect those subtle cognitive impairments and intervention effects may not be evident in standard behavioral or clinical assessments. Functional MRI (fMRI) findings in AD and MCI using the similar word repetition paradigm will also be discussed.

data.abstract: 底特律曾是享誉全球的汽车城,美国第四大城市,成为美国式梦幻城市的象征。然而,由于种族冲突、汽车制造产业衰落和产业转型受阻,昔日繁华已成旧梦,林立的高楼渐成空壳;白人逃离,企业撤退,犯罪高企,底特律被 " 抛弃 " 走向破产,戏称为 " 史上最悲催城市 " 。底特律人口已由高峰期 200 万人骤降至 71 万人( 2010 年),其中非洲裔超过 80% ,失业率高达 40% ,在城市衰败、产业萧条和公共服务紧缺背景中,很多非洲裔女性顽强地寻找机会,积极在非正规部门创业就业,为自己和家庭撑起生存空间。 Swider 教授久居底特律,对此地非洲裔女性就业进行了长期跟踪调查研究,讲座将全景式展示底特律非裔美国女性非正规就业的状况和问题,并探讨底特律城市未来发展的出路。

data.topic: Individual differences in face cognition abilities and their neural underpinnings: Findings and future directions ( 面孔认知能力的个体差异及其神经基础:研究成果及未来研究方向 )
data.speaker: Werner Sommer
data.speakerAffiliation: 德国柏林洪堡大学心理学系
data.listTitle: 本周五（28号）下午德国洪堡大学Werner Sommer客座教授聘任仪式兼学术报告
data.abstract: Fast and accurate processing of faces (person identity, emotion, speech movements, gender, attractiveness) is essential for human communication and interaction. Although much work has been done on the general processes and mechanisms of this astonishing human ability, there is much less research on the large differences between individual humans. In my presentation I will first explain cognitive models of face processing and the neural underpinnings derived from experimental and clinical work. Then I will turn to individual differences in face cognition with a focus on how our research with event-related brain potentials has contributed to elucidate the underlying neurocognitive mechanisms. Ongoing work is following up on a puzzling but consistent finding, namely the contrast between finding domain-specific abilities in accuracy (power) tasks and domain-general abilities in speed tasks. WernerSommer客座教授聘任仪式兼学术
data.speakerBio: Werner Sommer 教授早年毕业于德国维尔茨堡大学,并在康斯坦茨大学获得心理学博士学位,现为德国柏林洪堡大学心理学系教授。曾任德国洪堡大学心理系主任、认知冲突跨学科研究中心主任。一直致力于生物心理学、心理物理学的研究,是国际顶尖 ERP 研究专家,其研究兴趣主要包括认知心理生理学(脑电的心理学意义)、面孔加工、语言加工、双任务加工及反应准备等领域。在国际重要学术杂志发表论文二百余篇,主持各级各类项目经费约 350 万欧元。 个人主页: http://www.psychology.hu-berlin.de/profship/bio/pubs/mit_pub_1?pid=4489

data.title: 第51期心理沙龙
data.topic: Neural networks supporting rule learning, application, and switching (规则学习、运用和转换的大脑神经网络)
data.speaker: 刘志雅
data.listTitle: 第51期心理沙龙
data.abstract: We identified dynamic changes in recruitment of neural connectivity networks across three phases of a rule learning task: switching, rule learning via hypothesis testing, and rule application. During fMRI scanning, subjects viewed pairs of stimuli that differed across four dimensions (letter, color, size, screen location), chose one stimulus, and received feedback. Subjects were informed that the correct choice was determined by a simple unidimensional rule, for example "choose the blue letter." Once each rule had been learned and correctly applied for 4-7 trials, subjects were cued via either negative feedback or visual cues to switch to learning a new rule. Task performance was divided into three phases: Switching (first trial after receiving the switch cue), rule learning (subsequent trials through the last error trial), and rule application (correct responding after the rule was learned). Switching was associated with a limbic intrinsic connectivity network including the ventral striatum, thalamus, and parahippocampal gyrus. Rule learning was associated with broad fronto-parietal-striatal recruitment of regions associated with the cognitive control, dorsal attention, and salience networks. The default mode network and somatomotor networks showed a relative increase in activity during rule application. We further investigated the effects of switching cue on shifting. All cues were associated with activity in the ventral striatum; externally cued shifts (via visual feature change or other visual cue) were associated with additional visual cortical activity in comparison with switching cued solely by negative feedback.

data.topic: It's there whether or not you hear it: Syntactic representation of missing arguments (无论你是否听到它都在那:题元丢失下的句法表征现象)
data.speaker: Holly Branigan
data.speakerAffiliation: 英国爱丁堡大学心理系
data.listTitle: 英国爱丁堡大学Holly Branigan教授学术讲座
data.abstract: Any complete model of language processing must specify not only the processes that are involved, but also the relevant representations. However, there has been relatively little experimental research on the nature of syntactic representations. In this talk, I will consider how syntactic representation can be studied experimentally using structural priming paradigms, allowing us to investigate experimentally questions that have not been resolved using traditional theoretical linguistic methods. I will present two structural priming experiments that investigate how people represent sentences involving missing arguments in Mandarin, contrasting a "syntactically-represented" account whereby people postulate a syntactic representation for the missing argument, with a "syntactically-non-represented" account whereby people represent a missing argument semantically but do not postulate any syntactic representation for it. The results suggest that people construct the same constituent structure for missing-argument sentences and full-form sentences, in accord with the syntactically-represented account. I will discuss the implications for syntactic representations in language processing.
data.speakerBio: Holly Branigan教授,英国爱丁堡大学心理系教授,是心理语言学研究领域的知名专家。Branigian教授的研究主要集中在单语和双语者语言产生过程的认知机制,语言交互包括人与人之间、人与计算机之间交互的认知机制等研究领域。至今已在Trends in Cognitive Science, Cognition, Psychological Science, Journal of Memory and Language, Journal of Experimental Psychology, Developmental Science等国际权威学术期刊发表论文超过80篇,并担任心理语言学领域著名期刊如Journal of Memory and Language, Language Acquisition, Language and Linguistics Compass的编委工作。由于Branigan教授在心理语言学的杰出贡献,获得由英国科学院颁发的勒伍豪信托高级研究奖(British Academy/Leverhulme Trust Senior Research Fellow,2014-2015)。 主页: http://www.research.ed.ac.uk/portal/en/persons/holly-branigan(c3eab9e6-6cbc-4eb4-8fd9-fad1d10842da).html

data.topic: Does democracy change the Environmental Kuznets Curve? Evidence from air visibility
data.speaker: 袁嘉
data.speakerBio: Yuan Jia ,明尼苏达大学博士,现为澳门大学助理教授。主要研究领域为: Empirical Industrial Organization, Applied Economics 。曾在 Journal of Economics Behavior and Organization , Journal of Comparative Economics , Journal of Gambling Studies , Ecological Economics , Economic Inquiry 等期刊发表论文多篇。
data.abstract: It is commonly found that pollution intensity first rises with economic growth but then retreats as the GDP per capita reaches a certain threshold, thus supporting the Environment Kuznets Curve (EKC) hypothesis. However, this could merely be an illusion for countries without democracy. In theory, the threshold of the EKC could be too high to reach for countries without democracy even though it is low for democratic ones. Existing empirical evidence, however, largely represents the democratic world due to the systematic lack of pollution data in non-democratic countries. Econometrically, this non-representative sampling may bias the estimates of the EKC for both types of economies. In this study, we propose a solution by employing a unique global air visibility database that covers the entire world. In addition, we apply linguistic diversity as an instrumental variable to address the potential endogeneity in democracy following Barro (1999). Our empirical findings suggest a strikingly large gap between the turning points of the EKC of countries with different levels of democracy. Specifically, although an EKC relationship still exists in weak-democracy countries, their turning points are around US$ 14,000, which double those of countries with a high level of democracy and well above the average income level of the autocratic countries (around US$ 6,800).

data.title: 刘潇博士学术讲座通知
data.topic: Competing Openly or Blindly in Crowdsourcing Contests?
data.speaker: 刘潇
data.speakerBio: 清华大学助理教授,密歇根大学博士。研究方向为实验经济学、行为经济学和博弈论。曾在Management Science,Games and Economic Behavior等管理学和经济学顶级期刊发表论文多篇。
data.abstract: Organizations are increasingly outsourcing tasks once performed in-house to wider participants on the Internet by hosting online contests. In practice, two types of mechanisms are used to organize these contests: simultaneous (blind) and sequential (open). In a simultaneous contest, contestants submit their solutions independently without access to one another's submissions, while in a sequential contest, contestants submit their solutions sequentially and each can view all prior submissions before making their decisions. Most prior theoretical and experimental research has focused on simultaneous contests, with only a handful that have studied sequential ones. In this paper, under the condition of incomplete information, we analytically show that simultaneous contests produce higher quality best solutions than sequential contests. Using a laboratory experiment, we test this theoretical prediction as well as the prediction that simultaneous contests are more efficient than sequential contests. Our data support both predictions. We also discover that as the number of contestants increases, the efficiency of sequential contests drops significantly, further reducing their performance relative to simultaneous contests.

data.topic: Common Value Auctions with Return Policies: An Experiment
data.speaker: 杜宁华
data.speakerAffiliation: 上海财经大学经济学院
data.speakerBio: 现任上海财经大学经济学院副教授、经济学实验室主任,博士生导师。2005年获得美国亚利桑那大学经济学博士学位,主攻实验经济学。亚利桑那大学的经济科学实验室是北美最早成立的实验经济学研究基地,由2002年诺贝尔经济学奖得主Vernon Smith创建。由于杜宁华的加盟,上海财经大学增设了实验经济学方向的博士点。杜宁华博士近年来致力于运用实验手段回答各种与市场机制相关的问题,其研究成果见于Games and Economic Behavior, European Economic Review, Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization,Decision Support Systems等著名国际学术期刊,以及《管理科学学报》等国内权威期刊。
data.abstract: In common-value second-price auctions of items with uncertain value, we examine the role of fixed-fee return policies that resemble many situations in real business practice: e.g., deposits in oil field auctions, mineral and gas right auctions, spectrum auctions , and money-back guarantees with fixed shipping and handling charges in eBay auctions. Theory makes the prediction that a more generous return policy will hurt the winning bidder by eroding consumer surplus through higher bids. Theory also demonstrates that the seller's revenue increases as the handling fee for returning the auctioned item decreases, but remains positive. For free returns, there are multiple equilibria, all involving zero consumer surplus for the winning bidder, but with different implications for sellers. In our experimental setting, items may have a high value of 100 or a low value of 0 with an a priori 50% probability of each outcome. There are experimental four treatments: No Return (NR), High Fee (HF), Low Fee (LF) and Free Return (FR). We observe that bids increase and bidders' earnings decrease when the handling fee decreases as predicted. However, we also observe that in the FR treatment many bidders bid above the highest possible value and subsequently return the item regardless of the revealed value. While this is consistent with equilibrium behavior, it is an equilibrium that is not optimal for the seller. 杜宁华老师的简介:现任上海财经大学经济学院副教授、经济学实验室主任,博士生导师。2005年获得美国亚利桑那大学经济学博士学位,主攻实验经济学。亚利桑那大学的经济科学实验室是北美最早成立的实验经济学研究基地,由2002年诺贝尔经济学奖得主Vernon Smith创建。由于杜宁华的加盟,上海财经大学增设了实验经济学方向的博士点。杜宁华博士近年来致力于运用实验手段回答各种与市场机制相关的问题,其研究成果见于Games and Economic Behavior, European Economic Review, Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization,Decision Support Systems等著名国际学术期刊,以及《管理科学学报》等国内权威期刊。

data.abstract: Do you think there are great differences between China and the U.S. in teachers' and students'perceptions of school climate? With a sample included 3,253 students and 345 teachers in China and 2,192 students and 540 teachers in the U.S, our study found some interesting results. Cultural differences are given that likely account for the findings, including differences in the valuing of education, filial piety, social harmony. Another study will be reported is "Shame, guilt, blaming, and anger: Differences between children in Japan and the US". Recent research and theory on shame and guilt has highlighted the ''dark side to shame'' in motivating harmful behavior. Although researchers recognize that cultural differences in shame exist, few studies have examined such differences. Findings of the present study suggest that in anger, the ''dark side to shame'' but also the more positive side to guilt, are moderated by cultural context.

data.title: Arthur C. Graesser教授学术讲座
data.topic: How Can Computer Analyses of Language, Text, and Conversation Be Woven into Learning and Assessment?
data.speaker: Arthur C. Graesser
data.listTitle: Arthur C. Graesser教授学术讲座
data.abstract: Recent advances in computational linguistics and discourse processing have made it possible to analyze naturalistic texts and conversation on multiple levels of language and discourse. These advances are influencing the world of assessments of reading, writing, mathematics, science, reasoning, problem solving, and other competencies. This presentation reports examples of these assessments that analyze natural language. Coh-Metrix ( http://cohmetrix.com ) analyzes texts on multiple measures of language and discourse that are aligned with multilevel theoretical frameworks of discourse comprehension and production. Several dozen measures funnel into five major factors that systematically vary as a function of types of texts (e.g., narrative versus informational) and grade level: narrativity, syntactic simplicity, word concreteness, referential cohesion, and deep (causal) cohesion. A composite measure called formality increases with low narrativity, syntactic complexity, word abstractness, and high cohesion.Coh-Metrix has also been used to analyze student writing and conversation, even though its central focus is on scaling printed text. Learning has occurred over millennia by the learner communicating with the teacher, tutor, master, or mentor in natural language. Apprenticeship learning has always occurred one-on-one or in small groups with an expert. Researchers in the discourse and learning sciences have documented the conversation patterns that occur in these interactions. Researchers in computational linguistics, artificial intelligence, and intelligent tutoring systems have developed computer agents that simulate many of these conversation patterns and help people learn. This presentation will present recent systems on the internet that help students learn by holding a conversation in natural language. AutoTutor engages in dialogue with the student on a variety of subject matters in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics. Trialogs are conversations between the human students and two computer agents, typically a student agent and a tutor agent. Students can either observe two agents interact vicariously, interact with a tutor agent as a student agent periodically chimes in, or teach a student agent while a tutor rescues a problematic interaction. Agents can argue with each other over issues and ask what the human students think about the argument. Trialogs are being developed for the Internet in serious games with Pearson Education (Operation ARA), in assessments with Educational Testing Service, in training environments with the US Army and Navy, and in a new Center for the Study of Adult Literacy for struggling adult readers. AutoMentor is being developed for computer mediated communication between a mentor agent and small groups of students in a simulation game on urban planning. Tests of these systems have shown very encouraging learning gains. Title: How Can Computer Analyses of Language, Text, and Conversation Be Woven into Learning and Assessment? Spea

data.topic: 改善帕金森症的冲动控制缺损
data.speaker: 叶铮
data.listTitle: 叶铮博士学术讲座
data.speakerBio: 叶铮毕业于北京大学,在周晓林教授的指导下获得博士学位。她先后在德国吕贝克大学和英国剑桥大学工作,研究帕金森症语言障碍和认知控制障碍的多巴胺能、去甲肾上腺素能和五羟色胺能神经机制。 2014 年进入 Donders 研究所,与 Roshan Cools 和 Peter Hagoort 一起探索语言与认知控制的神经药物学。 详见: www.researchgate.net/profile/Zheng_Ye/ 演讲内容 : 近年来帕金森症及其常规治疗引发的控制能力缺损越来越引起关注。美国和加拿大的流行病学研究显示, 13.6% 的帕金森病人患有严重的冲动控制障碍。即使未被确诊冲动控制障碍,大部分帕金森病人依然表现出冲动行为和冲动决策。更糟的是,多巴胺类抗帕金森药对治疗行为控制障碍鲜有成效。在过去的三年中,我们在剑桥的研究小组另辟蹊径,探索了行为控制的去甲肾上腺素能和五羟色胺能神经机制,重点考察选择性去甲肾上腺素再摄取抑制剂(阿托西汀)和五羟色胺再摄取抑制剂(西酞普兰)的治疗效果。在演讲的第一部分,我将展示在轻度帕金森病人中进行的一系列药物 - 脑成像研究。这些研究表明,用阿托西汀或西酞普兰提升前额叶的去甲肾上腺素或五羟色胺水平能够在行为水平和脑激活水平上显著改善患者的反应抑制能力。在第二部分,我将展示一种基于机器学习的新模型,它能根据患者的个体特征和临床症状预测药物的疗效。这一模型能在未来的临床试验和临床治疗中发挥作用,为每位病人选择最适合的治疗方案,为每种药物选择最适合的治疗人群。

data.topic: 身体攻击与社会性攻击的发展:同伴社会交往的作用 (Physical and Social Aggression in Development: Peer Social Processes)
data.speaker: 谢红灵
data.listTitle: 谢红灵博士学术讲座
data.abstract: 社会性攻击(如传播谣言、社会疏离等)是近年来发展心理学领域所探讨的一种独特的攻击形式。使用两项追踪研究的数据,本次讲座将介绍社会性攻击及其与同伴网络中的高社交地位的交互作用。其次,将回顾当前研究中不同的攻击形式与同伴关系的交互作用。另外,本讲座还将涵盖同伴影响身体攻击和社会性攻击的其它相关主题,并讨论未来研究的方向。
data.speakerBio: 谢红灵博士早年于北京大学获得心理学学士学位,于美国北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校(University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill )获得发展心理学博士学位,现为美国天普大学(Temple University)心理系副教授。她的研究专注于儿童青少年的身体与社交形式的攻击与侵害、学校同伴社交网络中的社交地位及同伴组别归属、以及同伴社交网络与攻击和侵害的关系。其研究获得美国国家科学基金会、美国国立卫生研究院(NIMH & NICHD)、William T. Grant基金会和Harry Frank Guggenheim基金会的资助,研究成果发表于Developmental Psychology、Aggressive Behavior等发展心理学的主要杂志。谢红灵博士现任International Journal of Behavioral Development 和Journal of Emotional and Behavioral Disorders的编委及多家心理学、教育学和社会学重要期刊的审稿人。 更多谢红灵教授介绍请参见: http://www.cla.temple.edu/psychology/faculty/hongling-xie/

data.title: （周四）下午3点半到5点半心理学学术沙龙
data.topic: Is consciousness a blessing or a curse? ( 意识 : 是恩典还是诅咒？ )
data.speaker: 林志成
data.listTitle: （周四）下午3点半到5点半心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: Why do we have consciousness? What is it for? Understanding the function of consciousness is one of most fundamental and difficult problem in science. In this talk, I will focus on consciousness in the visual domain, things that we see and become conscious of. My approach is to contrast visual processes that do not require awareness with those that do. The first part of the talk will address a basic measurement question—what is the proper way of measuring awareness in the first place?—in the context of a new phenomenon called priming of awareness. The second part of the talk will provide evidence showing that integrating information from two different objects (e.g., whether two shapes are the same or different) can occurs without awareness, but binding of shape and color within an object—such as recognizing an object as a red apple or a green pear, but not the reverse—requires conscious awareness. This latter finding points to feature binding as a unique function endowed by conscious awareness—consciousness as a blessing. The final part of the talk will show that robust attentional orienting and alerting can be evoked by invisible, but not visible, cues; in other words, visual attention can be better captured when we are not aware of its source—consciousness as a curse. Consciousness therefore can be both a blessing and a curse in visual processing .
data.speakerBio: 林志成博士, 2007 年本科毕业于北京大学心理系, 2012 年于美国明尼苏达大学心理系获得博士学位,导师为何生教授。目前在美国华盛顿大学从事博士后工作。林志成博士的工作主要集中在视觉、注意和意识等研究领域。至今已在 Journal of experimental psychology: Human Perception and Performance, Cognition, Psychological Science, Journal of vision, Biological Psychology 等国际著名学术杂志发表论文十余篇,并在 Cortex, Behavioral and Brain Sciences 以及 Journal of neuroscience 杂志发表三篇评论文章。林志成博士于 2008 年获得美国心理学会早期研究者奖,于 2013 年获得明尼苏达大学最佳论文奖,于 2014 年获得意识科学研究学会威廉詹姆斯奖。

data.topic: Toward understanding APP function in GABAergic synapse and neuronal circuit (揭秘淀粉样蛋白前提 APP 在 GABA 能突触以及神经环路的功能)
data.speaker: 杨莉
data.listTitle: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: The neuropathological hallmarks of Alzheimer's disease (AD) are characterized by accumulation of extracellular amyloid plaques along with intraneuronal neurofibrillary tangles, neuronal/ synaptic loss and progressive learning and memory impairment. Beta-amyloid (Aβ) is a cleavage product of amyloid precursor protein (APP). Although much focus has been giving to Aβ in trying to understand the pathogenesis of AD, the function of full-length APP is not fully understood and it is likely that full-length APP performs distinct roles from its cleavage products. Considering the importance of neuronal and synaptic deficits that occurred much earlier than Aβ deposition in the onset and progression of AD, an understanding of how intrinsic-neuronal, synaptic and circultry function is manipulated by APP may reveal how aberrant modulation of APP leads to pathogenesis of AD. We have shown that APP interacts with α1C subunit of L-type voltage-gated calcium channel. APP deficiency results in reduced protein levels of α1C subunit of L-type voltage-gated calcium channel in GABAergic neurons, leading to altered GABAergic short term plasticity. However, the precise role of APP in GABAergic synapse is still unclear. Using electrophysiological, immunohistochemical and molecular biological techaniques, we uncovered important roles of APP in regulating GABAergic synaptic and consequent circuitry activities. APP deficiency results in altered GABAR and KCC2 protein levels, leading to reduced amplitude of GABAAR mediated IPSCs and a positive shift of the GABAAR reversal potential. Furthermore, aberrant cortical network activity observed in mutant was rescued by modulating GABAR activity. In addition to reveal critical role of APP in neuronal function, our findings may have important implications for the understanding of disease mechanisms and therapeutic target in AD.

data.location: 文2栋3楼经济学系办公室
data.speaker: 刘愿
data.abstract: 企业家精神是经济增长的源泉,企业创新是中国实现从经济大国向经济强国跨越的关键。1998年住房制度改革后,我国房地产市场迅猛发展,房地产价格不断上涨,高房价重新激活了中国社会"买田置地"的传统。理论分析表明,在房地产投资高回报条件下,企业家所面临的约束条件发生变化;在给定资源禀赋下,企业增加房地产投资减少企业创新投入,高房价抑制了企业创新。根据2000-2012年中国2400多家上市公司和252个城市的匹配数据的实证研究表明,高房价一方面促进了企业房地产投资,另一方面抑制了企业研发投入,企业房地产投资的确挤出了企业研发投入,这一效应在民营企业中表现得尤为突出。中国企业家精神因高房价而陨落。

data.topic: 多组 SEM 检验测量等同性:卡方检验的问题与对策
data.speaker: 袁克海
data.listTitle: 袁克海教授学术讲座
data.abstract: 当各组的总体协方差矩阵存在差异时, 可以通过观察能否用同一个因子模型来拟合各组的样本协方差矩阵来证实测量不变性,这种不变性称为"形态等同"。形态等同成立后,再依次进行负荷等同、因子方差协方差等同以及误差方差等同检验。本文认为上述检验无法很好地控制一类错误率或统计检验力,然后通过分析和实例指出卡方检验为何在多组分析时容易误用,最后用蒙特卡洛模拟研究进一步支持了上述分析结论。

data.title: （周四）下午5点到6点心理学学术沙龙
data.topic: The psychology of predictably irrational decision making ( 非理性决策的心理学研究 )
data.speaker: 余荣军
data.listTitle: （周四）下午5点到6点心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: Every day, people are inundated with decisions, ranging from the most trivial ones ("Tea or coffee?") to the most important choices ("Should I get married now?"). Traditional economic theories assume that an individual acts as if balancing costs against benefits to reach a decision that maximizes personal advantage. However, even very smart people make decisions that deviate from these theoretical predictions. Such systematic 'errors' are known as decision biases. I use novel behavioral paradigms combined with neuroimaging methods to study why people fall prey to biases, such as defaults biases, sunk costs, conformity, and inequity aversion. My research suggests that the processing of cost/benefit information is heavily susceptible to contextual information rather than determined by objective values. Analytic, rational thinking can be dominated by strong anticipatory feelings and social emotions, which can elicit suboptimal decisions. These findings may enhance the understanding of decision biases and can be used to help nudge people to make better choices.

data.topic: The Dynamics of Eye Movements and Attention During Reading: Contributions of Cross-Language Comparisons ( 阅读过程中眼动和注意的动态关系:来自跨语言的比较研究 )
data.location: 心理学院五楼学术报告厅
data.speaker: Reinhold Kliegl
data.speakerAffiliation: 德国波茨坦大学认知心理学系
data.listTitle: Reinhold Kliegl 教授学术讲座
data.abstract: Differences between languages and how they are written give us unique opportunities to address three controversial issues in eye-movement control during reading. The three issues are (1) whether the predictability of the next word influences fixation durations before the eye gets to the word; (2) whether we can get the meaning of words before we look at them; and (3) whether information other than initial letters and word length of the next word influence where we send the eyes. Eye movements collected from reading German, English, Spanish, Chinese (both simplified and traditional), and Uighur suggest affirmative answers to these questions.

data.topic: Parafoveal Processing of Chinese Deaf Readers during Sentence Reading (聋人在中文句子阅读过程中对副中央凹区域的信息加工特点 ) 讲座
data.speaker: 潘敬儿
data.listTitle: 潘敬儿、阎鸣博士学术讲座
data.abstract: Phonological processing plays an important role in reading acquisition. However, recent studies suggest that deaf reads might use different coding strategies rather than phonological coding while reading. The present studies aimed to investigate the coding strategy of Chinese deaf readers. Different from the well-known sequential activation route of orthography, phonology, and semantics in alphabetic scripts, Chinese is well-optimized for fast semantic activation. Given the lack of auditory input among deaf readers and the characteristic of Chinese, in the first study, we examined whether Chinese deaf readers have more direct access to parafoveal semantic information. Results clearly indicate parafoveal semantic information is obtained earlier among the deaf readers than reading-level matched hearing readers. In the second study, we asked whether there is a coding strategy that is uniquely adopted by deaf readers. We examined whether sign translation of a word is activated in the parafovea. Results indicate that Chinese deaf readers activate sign language translation of parafoveal words during reading, and processing sign phonologically related previews inhibits recognition of the target words. 第二部分: 4:00-5:20

data.title: （周五）Kara D.Federmeier教授学术讲座
data.topic: Time for Meaning: What electrophysiology reveals about how the brain makes sense of the world ( 大脑获得 " 意义 " 的
data.location: 心理学院五楼学术报告厅
data.speaker: Kara D. Federmeier
data.speakerAffiliation: 美国伊利诺伊斯大学香槟分校及贝克曼研究所
data.listTitle: （周五）Kara D.Federmeier教授学术讲座
data.abstract: How does the human brain so rapidly and reliably link complex perceptual stimuli, such as words, to the information stored in long-term memory that constitutes the "meaning" of those words? Electrophysiological data suggest that meaning is accessed through a stimulus-elicited, temporally-delimited process that binds neural activity across a distributed, multimodal brain network. In contrast to long-standing views that treat the recognition of words (and other meaningful stimuli) as occurring primarily through feed-forward processing that it relatively impervious to context, our work has shown that the language comprehension system uses context information to predict semantic and even perceptual features of likely upcoming words. The fact that some information may be available to the brain even before the word actually appears is likely an important part of what allows meaning processing to be as fast and effective as it usually is. However, although prediction seems important for comprehension, it also appears susceptible to age-related deterioration and can be associated with processing costs. Intriguingly, our research suggests that the brain might use both predictive and more "bottom-up" processing strategies in parallel, distributed across the left and right cerebral hemispheres. In particular, we have shown that whereas the right hemisphere processes language inputs in a feedforward manner, the left hemisphere is more likely to generate predictions, perhaps because comprehension mechanisms are integrated with language production mechanisms only in the left hemisphere, which is strongly dominant for speech. Overall, our research has revealed that there is a "time for meaning".

data.topic: Neural Bases of Addressed and Assembled phonologies: The Role of Native Language Experience (语音提取和语音拼读的神经机制:母语经验的影响)
data.speaker: 梅磊磊
data.listTitle: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: A key component of reading is phonological access, i. e., the association of visual words with their sounds. Two distinct routes of phonological access, addressed phonology (i.e., whole-word mapping) and assembled phonology (i.e., grapheme-to-phoneme mapping), have been identified. Nevertheless, questions remain regarding how the two phonological access routes are instantiated in the human brain and how they are modulated by native language experience. By using an artificial language training paradigm, we identified the ventral and dorsal neural pathways for addressed and assembled phonologies, respectively. More interestingly, we found that the neural bases of addressed and assembled phonologies were shaped by native language experience. Specifically, one key region for addressed phonology (i.e., the left middle temporal gyrus) showed greater activation for addressed phonology in native Chinese speakers, while one key region for assembled phonology (i.e., the left supramarginalgyrus) showed more activation for assembled phonology in native English speakers.These results support the dual-route models of reading and have important implications for the interaction between native and second languages.

data.abstract: People derive positive self-evaluations from personal, relational, and collective identities.Past research has mostly focused onindividuals' evaluations ofpersonal and collective identity, with little research devoted to understanding relational self-esteem.In the research reviewed here, a scale was developed to measure relational self-esteem and the function of relational self-esteem in buffering anxiety and promoting psychological well-being was investigated. Study 1 provides evidence for the reliability and validity of the scale. In Study 2, relational self-esteem was found to serve as an anxiety buffer against the existential fear of death, an d this buffering effect was found to be more salient among collectivists than individualists.Study 3 revealed that relational self-esteem may promote psychological well-being and serve as a mediator between social support and psychological well-being.Taken together, these studies provide unique and emerging findings regarding the development of a theory of relational self-esteem.

data.topic: Sinful flesh: Sexual objectification threatens women's moral self (罪恶的肉体:物化降低女性主观道德感)
data.speaker: 滕飞
data.listTitle: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: Sexual objectification refers to the tendency to value women solely on the basis of the utility of sexual parts or sexual functions. It happens on a daily basis through mass media portrayals as well as interpersonal encounters, and prior research has thoroughly documented its degrading effects on women. For example, comparing to their non-objectified counterparts, objectified women were attributed less mind, regarded as less competent, and even viewed as less than human. The present investigation extended the literature to examine the effects of sexual objectification on women's self-perception. Specifically, we investigated whether sexual objectification would lead women to feel contaminated, which triggers sinful feelings. The results of three experiments provide converging support for these predictions. Female participants reported greater sinful feelings than their non-objectified counterparts, after receiving objectifying comments on their physical appearance from an alleged male partner (Experiment 1) or recalling a past experience of objectification (Experiments 2 and 3). Furthermore, perceived contamination mediated the effect of objectification on sinful feelings. We also found that perceived personal responsibility of being objectified moderated the above effects, such that the effects were only observed among participants who perceived themselves as highly responsible for objectification experience, but not among those who perceived low personal responsibility. These findings contribute to the literature by explaining why objectification elicits sinful feelings in female victims and who is more susceptible to this influence.

data.speaker: 马超

data.abstract: 根据社会交换理论,组织需要员工加盟完成组织的任务,为资本创造利润;而员工到组织工作则是为了获得薪酬回报( compensation ),这种回报包括经济性薪酬和非经济性薪酬。而经济性薪酬又分成直接和间接经济性薪酬。直接经济薪酬包括工资、奖金、佣金等;间接经济薪酬包括社会保险、假期津贴、非业绩奖金的津贴、服务设施费等。非经济性薪酬包括表扬、自尊、认可等。我们重点关注经济性薪酬。然而,员工如何知觉组织支付的经济性薪酬？不同的经济性薪酬项目(如工资、奖金、福利、社会保险等)在员工心目中如何分类储存的？员工的各类心理账户在汇总计量时的权重如何？这些心理感知对员工的薪酬满意度和行为可能产生哪些影响？迫切需要进行理论研究,以便为人力资源管理提供可操作的原则和办法,在相同支出时提高薪酬激励的效果,最终提升组织的竞争力。

data.title: 学术讲座
data.speaker: Tom Verguts
data.listTitle: 学术讲座
data.abstract: Learning and cognitive control are often portrayed as functional opposites: In familiar situations, we rely on (learned) habits, in novel situations, we exert cognitive control. Ironically, however, over the last decade computational modeling on how cognitive control is mechanistically implemented, is revealing a fundamental role for learning in cognitive control. In my earliest work in this domain, I investigated the role of Hebbian learning in cognitive control; later of reinforcement learning in cognitive control; and finally the role of cost (effort) processing as one specific dimension of value. Behavioral, fMRI, and modeling work from each of the three lines will be discussed in the talk. CV - 2001: PhD in psychology (KULeuven) - 2002: Assistant professor (Ghent University) - 2012: Full professor (Ghent University) Representative publications Verguts, T., & Notebaert, W. (2009). Adaptation by binding: a learning account of cognitive control. Trends in cognitive sciences , 13 (6), 252–7. Roggeman, C., Santens, S., Fias, W., & Verguts, T. (2011). Stages of nonsymbolic number processing in occipitoparietal cortex disentangled by fMRI adaptation. Journal of neuroscience , 31 (19), 7168–73. Silvetti, M., Alexander, W. data.topic: 社会网络分析及在心理研究中的应用
data.speaker: 唐文清
data.listTitle: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: 个体所处的社会情境对其心理与行为有重要影响,人类所处的社会情境主要指个体所嵌入的各种社会关系网络。社会网络分析(Social Network Analysis)是对社会关系进行量化分析的技术,从"关系"的角度测量和描述个体之间关系及包含的信息,揭示群体结构以及群体结构与心理与行为的相互作用,在人格研究、发展与教育心理研究、组织管理心理研究都有重要应用。社会网络分析可通过个体水平的模型和关系水平的模型探索网络结构及心理与行为。指数随机图模型(Exponential Family Random Graph Models) 是建立在关系水平上的统计模型,用于描述固定节点集图的概率分布,可同时分析社会网络中复杂的关系结构和属性特征之间的关系,是社会网络研究中最受关注的模型。研究在概述社会网络分析的概念、特点、统计方法、研究思路的基础上,重点介绍指数随机图模型。最后,从整体社会网络分析研究取向出发,以高一年级班级网络分析为例,采集社会网络关系数据及个体属性数据,逐步纳入网络结构参数和个体属性参数建立班级网络的随机指数图模型,阐明社会网络分析在心理研究的应用过程。

data.topic: Impact of eye-movements and parafoveal preview on EEG correlates of word recognition: A comparison between natural reading and RSVP (词汇加工过程中眼动和预视加工相关的EEG效应:来自自然阅读和快速序列呈现的比较研究)
data.speaker: Florian
data.speakerAffiliation: Humboldt University Berlin, 德国洪堡大学
data.listTitle: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: Visual word recognition (VWR) naturally takes place under reading conditions that involve eye movements and parafoveal preprocessing of the upcoming word. Event-related potential (ERP) studies have usually neglected both aspects when studying VWR with serial visual presentation (SVP). Recently, it was suggested that preview can be studied by presenting parafoveal flanker words during SVP. An alternative method is to let participants read naturally and time-lock the EEG to the onsets of fixations, yielding fixation-related potentials (FRPs). This study combined eye tracking and EEG to compare both approaches. Participants read lists of nouns of varying lexical frequency. In FRP blocks, lists were read naturally from left to right. In ERP blocks, subjects maintained fixation while lists moved word-by-word through foveal vision at a reading speed closely matching the FRP condition. In both paradigms, parafoveal words were either visible or masked with x-letters. Classic effects of word frequency were replicated across conditions. Importantly, the availability of correct previews strongly modulated the waveshapes of both ERPs and FRPs. However, these preview effects were substantially larger in natural reading, presumably because attention is shifted to upcoming words during saccade preparation. Results underline the importance of considering saccades and preview in electrophysiological VWR research.

data.topic: A Demographic Theory of Reform
data.speaker: Stephen Chiou
data.abstract: This paper explores the role of population structure and dynamic in determining the choice of economic reform strategies. It is motivated by economic reform experiences in China, which pursued a gradual approach, and Russia, which pursued a big bang approach. At the beginning of reforms, the Chinese population was much younger and, despite its birth control policy, has continued growing in the next half century, with 40 percent increase in size; whereas the Russian population was much older, peaked soon, and has since remained stagnant. The investment nature of reform---pain now, gain later---suggests that demographic structure and dynamic like those in China might bestow the government with a lot of leeway for manipulation (a corollary being that a self-interested government may use the leeway for procrastination). In the absence of such demographic conditions, a benevolent government may find it necessary to commit to reform through a big bang.

data.abstract: 非自杀性自伤( nonsuicidal self-injury ,简称自伤),是指不以自杀为目的,直接和有意的伤害自己身体组织的行为。常见的自伤行为包括:割伤、咬伤、拳打自己、以头或身体其它部位撞墙、抓伤、用尖锐物体插入指甲或皮肤、及烧伤等。近 10 年来,自伤在全世界范围内的发生率显著增加,已经成为重要的公共卫生问题。自伤具有严重的危害,影响个人的情绪和人际关系,甚至可能导致自杀行为。鉴于自伤的普遍性与临床意义,美国精神病学协会已将自伤作为独立的诊断列入精神疾病诊断与统计手册第五版( DSM-5 )"需要进一步研究的问题"中。在本次学术沙龙中,我将介绍自伤行为的特征及一个解释自伤行为发生发展的整合性模型,并介绍我在此模型框架下所做的几个考察自伤功能、自伤行为影响因素的研究。

data.speakerAffiliation: 美国宾夕法尼亚州立大学
data.listTitle: 3点到5点美国宾州州立大学李平教授客座教授聘任仪式和学术报告会
data.abstract: 简介: A great deal of research has examined behavioral performance changes associated with second language learning. But what changes are taking place in the brain as learning progresses? How can we identify whether the learner has or has not successfully learned an aspect of the new language? To answer these questions, researchers have developed a variety of methods and paradigms to study the neurocognitive processes of language acquisition. In our research, we have examined the cognitive performance and brain activities associated with second language learning using a fMRI pre-training and post-training paradigm, and attempt to identify the functional connectivity changes over time before and after training on new language vocabulary items. In addition, we identify the individual differences in the participants' cognitive skills, and link these to participants' learning success. Our findings indicate that cognitive skills including working memory and attentional control are positively associated with learning outcomes, and that learners develop more efficient and more integrated brain networks across the left and right hemispheres in key brain areas responsible for phonological and lexical-semantic representation and integration. These findings have significant implications for understanding the linguistic ability of the individual, differences between individuals, and the relationships between language abilities and cognitive capacities . 李平教授简介: 李平教授 1983 年在北京大学获得语言学学士学位, 1990 年在荷兰的马普心理语言学研究所获得心理学博士学位。随后在美国加州大学圣地亚哥分校的语言研究中心和 McDonald Pew 认知神经科学中心做博士后研究。他于 1992 年到 1996 年在香港中文大学任职, 1996 年转至美国的 University of Richmond 任心理学和认知科学教授。他目前是美国宾州州立大学的心理学教授、语言学教授、信息科学与技术学教授,兼任脑、行为和认知中心主任,神经科学研究生项目负责人,学习科学研究高级联合中心副主任。李平教授重点关注语言的神经和计算基础。他使用行为、计算和神经成像等方法来研究母语和二语获得与表征的机制。他在心理语言学、双语、认知神经科学等领域发表论著 100 多篇(部),其中有影响的专著有《 The Acquisition of Lexical and Grammatical Aspect (词汇和语法获得) 》,《 The Handbook of East Asian Psycholinguistics ( 东亚心理语言学手册)》,《 The Expression of Time ( 时态表达)》,《 The Psycholinguistics of Bilingualism (双语的心理语言学研究)》,《 Having Success with NSF: A Practical Guide ( 美国国家科学基金成功申报指南)》等。他目前是杂志《 Bilingualism: Language and Cognition 》的主编,《 Journal of Neurolinguistics 》和《 Frontiers in Language Science 》的副主编。曾任美国计算机心理学学会主席,美国国家科学基金认知神经科学项目组以及感觉、行动和认知项目组评委会主任,同时也是多项美国国家科学基金项目的首席专家。 详细信息见: http://cogsci.psu.edu/.or.http://blclab.org/ 李平教授客座教授聘任仪式及学术报告会

data.topic: My heart in your mind: 特质推断的神经机制研究
data.speaker: 马宁
data.listTitle: （周四）下午3点到4点半心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: 特质推断一直是社会认知研究的重要主题。近年来,随着社会认知神经科学的快速发展,很多研究开始探讨特质推断的神经机制。 fMRI研究表明在特质推断的任务中,人类的"社会性大脑"中前额叶(mPFC)和颞顶联合区(TPJ)被广泛激活,并且在出现不一致的社会性信息,个体需要对他人的特质进行更新时,大脑负责探测和解决冲突信息的脑区pmFC和Lateral PFC也会被激活。此外,人类"社会性大脑"在对社会性信息进行推断时也有不同的分工,TPJ主要负责对他人行为的理解,而mPFC主要对他人的特质进行识别和判断。进一步的研究利用fMRI adaptation的实验范式还证明了特质概念在大脑中前额叶的表征,这一结果为mPFC在社会认知中作用的研究提供了全新角度。 马宁博士简介: 马宁,博士毕业于比利时布鲁塞尔自由大学,主要从事社会推断的神经机制研究。现在美国宾夕法尼亚大学进行博士后研究,主要方向为睡眠剥夺的神经机制。其主要科研成果已在 Social Cognitive & Affective Neuroscience, Social Neuroscience等高水平国际社会神经科学期刊上发表10余篇,并于2011年获国家优秀自费留学生奖学金。同时,还担任Social Cognitive & Affective Neuroscience, Neuroscience & Biobehavioral Reviews, PLOS One等国际期刊审稿人。

data.abstract: A large body of knowledge has accumulated over the past decades on the cognitive and neural mechanisms underlying language processing and language acquisition. Much of this knowledge, however, has been derived from studies of Indo-European languages. Recent interests in the study of Chinese have shed new light on long-standing debates regarding language universals and language specificity. In particular, Chinese provides a unique test ground for neurocognitive and neurolinguistic theories due to its specific properties in phonology, grammar, and lexicon. In this talk, I present evidence from neurocognitive studies of Chinese as first language (L1) and second language (L2), using methodologies from psycholinguistics and cognitive neuroscience. Our studies focus on the dynamic processes in the language representation and processing systems and the dynamic changes that occur in the language learner. They indicate that language-specific properties, linguistic experience, and developmental characteristics of the learner jointly shape the cognitive and neural representations of native and non-native languages. Neurocognitive studies have thus enabled us to gain new insights into the complex relationships among language, culture, cognition and brain. 李平教授简介: Ping Li received his undergraduate education from Peking University , China and his graduate training from the Max Planck Institute for Psycholinguistics, the Netherlands , and obtained his Ph.D. in 1990. He subsequently did postdoctoral research at the University of California , San Diego in the Center for Research in Language and the McDonald Pew Center for Cognitive Neuroscience. He took a faculty position at the Chinese University of Hong Kong between 1992 and 1996, and moved to the University of Richmond in 1996, where he became Professor of Psychology and Cognitive Science. He is currently Professor of Psychology, Linguistics, and Information Sciences and Technology, and Director of the University Park Graduate Program in Neuroscience, Co-Director of the Center for Brain, Behavior, and Cognition, and Co-Director of the Advanced Joint Center for the Study of Learning Sciences. Li's research focuses on the neural and computational bases of language. He uses a variety of behavioral, computational, and neuroimaging tools to study mechanisms underlying the acquisition and representation of native and non-native languages. He has published widely in the areas of psycholinguistics, bilingualism, and cognitive neuroscience. His research has led to over 100 publications, including books such as The Acquisition of Lexical and Grammatical Aspect (co-authored with Yasuhiro Shirai, 2000, Mouton de Gruyter), The Handbook of East Asian Psycholinguistics (three volumes co-edited with colleagues, 2006, Cambridge University Press), The Expression of Time (co-edited with W. Klein, 2009, Mouton de Gruyter), The Psycholinguistics of Bilingualism (co-authored with François Grosjean, 2013, Wiley), and Having Success with NSF: A Practical Guide (co-authored with Karen Marrongelle, 2013, Wiley). He is Editor of the journal Bilingualism: Language and Cognition, Associate Editor of Journal of Neurolinguistics, and Associate Editor of Frontiers in Language Science. He has previously served as President of the Society for Computers in Psychology, Director for the Cognitive Neuroscience Program and the Program in Perception, Action, and Cognition at the US (NSF), as well as principal investigator, co-investigator, and consultant for many projects funded by NSF. For more information about Li's research, teaching, and administration, please visit http://cogsci.psu.edu/.or.http://blclab.org/ 学术

data.title: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.topic: Axonal Fiber Terminations Concentrate on Gyri
data.speaker: 聂晶鑫
data.listTitle: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: Convoluted cortical folding and neuronal wiring are two prominent attributes of the mammalian brain. However, the macro-scale intrinsic relationship between these two general cross-species attributes, as well as the underlying principles that sculpt the architecture of the cerebral cortex, remains unclear. Here we show that the axonal fibers connected to gyri are significantly denser, than the ones connected to sulci. We found that dominant percentages of axonal fibers are connected to gyri in human, chimpanzee and macaque monkey brains. This finding has been replicated in a range of mammalian brains via diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) and high angular resolution diffusion imaging (HARDI). These results might suggest fundamental mechanisms for development and organization of the cerebral cortex, and inspired us to hypothesize that axonal pushing is a mechanism of cortical folding and that gyri have significantly higher functional activities and long-distance interactions than sulci.

data.speaker: 陈彩琦
data.listTitle: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: N2pc是一种单侧脑后负波，其波幅常被用作对目标刺激注意分配量的指标，而其潜伏期则反映对目标刺激注意分配的时间点。Pd成分则是反映注意抑制的对侧枕颞皮层正波。二者在视觉认知的基础和临床研究中均有重要价值。本次沙龙将讨论这两种ERP成分的性质及其在工作记忆驱动的注意偏向研究和视觉忽视研究中的应用。

data.title: 袁克海教授学术讲座
data.topic: 使用随机系数回归模型分析调节效应
data.location: 心理学院五楼报告厅调节效应的分析在心理和行为科学研究中广为应用
data.speaker: 袁克海
data.listTitle: 袁克海教授学术讲座
data.abstract: 最常用的调节效应分析模型是有调节的多元回归模型 (MMR) ,其中解释变量包括乘积项或交互项,一般通过最小二乘法 (LS) 对模型进行估计。本文假定因变量对自变量的回归系数也受到调节变量的影响,提出使用随机系数回归模型进行调节效应分析,同时还开发出一种基于正态分布的极大似然比 (NML) 算法来估计模型参数,给出了参数估计值的标准误计算公式。结果表明,当误差方差不齐性时,随机系数模型的 NML 估计可以提供比 MMR 模型的 LS 估计更有效和更精确的参数估计值。
data.speakerBio: 袁克海博士,美国圣母大学心理系教授,兼任我校心理学院客座教授。他在 UCLA 获得博士学位,研究兴趣包括结构方程模型、中介分析和调节分析、多水平模型、混合模型、项目反映理论、元分析等。他在 Structural Equation Modeling, Psychological Methods, Psychometrika, British Journal of Mathematical and Statistical Psychology, Multivariate Behavioral Research 等国际重要期刊上发表了上 100 篇学术论文。 袁教授目前是 Psychological Methods 和 Journal of Multivariate Analysis 两个期刊的副主编,并兼任多个期刊的编委。

data.title: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.topic: Mechanisms underlying the reversals of the Simon effect: Evidence and implications for cognitive control
data.speaker: 王凌
data.listTitle: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: In this talk, I will present four studies using the paradigms of reversed Simon effect performed recently in our lab. Two functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) studies investigated neural correlates of learning and rule modulated cognitive control, respectively. The results suggest that dissociable mechanisms contribute to the effects of learning and rule on cognitive control. The learning effect might be mediated through the right frontopolar cortex, but the rule effect was represented by functional coupling between the medial prefrontal cortex and parieto-premotor areas and lateral prefrontal cortex. In addition, the other two (behavioral) studies further examined relationships between the effects of learning, rule and conflict context on cognitive control. The results suggest that conflict context plays a dominant role in modulating the Simon effect compared to the other two factors. The implications of the results for cognitive control will be discussed.

data.title: （周四）下午4点到5点学术沙龙
data.topic: 确信度作答方式的理论与应用
data.speaker: 张一平
data.listTitle: （周四）下午4点到5点学术沙龙
data.abstract: 在可用于多项选择题的作答方式中,多选一作答方式是最简单常用的答题方式。但是这一方式容易出现猜测答案的行为,被试只掌握部分知识或者根本不知道答案时也有可能选对答案。理论上,意大利数学家De Finetti(1965)提出的确信度作答方式(Probability Testing)是多项选择题的最佳作答方式。该方式不仅可以精确测量部分知识,还能提供被试对各选择项的主观确信程度的信息。这些关于被试的更精确、更详细的信息,在阅读理解、理论思考等高次元能力测量及学习诊断中具有很高价值。在本次沙龙中,将对确信度作答方式的理论与应用作初步介绍。

data.title: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.topic: 注视跟随系统(Gaze-contingent display)中的数据延迟及改善研究
data.speaker: 韩鹏
data.listTitle: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: 注视跟随系统在视科学、心理学研究中应用广泛。然而,数据从眼动仪向显示设备传输过程中,会存在明显的延迟,从而对某些实验结果产生一定的影响。我们提出了一种扫视(saccade)眼动的数学模型,可以在眼睛扫视时对注视点进行实时预测,从而可以弥补上述的延迟,改善注视跟随系统的实时性。通过在EyeLink 1000 and a Dual-Purkinje Image两种眼动仪中实验,发现该方法对大于8度的扫视有明显的改善。
data.speakerBio: 韩鹏,教授,博士生导师,物理与电信工程学院副院长。主要从事光电技术及系统方面的研究。先后主持国家自然科学基金、教育部科学研究重点项目、省部产学研项目等多个项目,发表文章40余篇,其中SCI收录20余篇,获国家发明专利授权6项,完成技术成果转让3项。

data.title: 英国普利茅斯大学蔡振光博士学术报告
data.topic: Mental representations and processes underlying language processing (语言加工中的心理表征与加工)
data.speaker: 蔡振光
data.listTitle: 英国普利茅斯大学蔡振光博士学术报告
data.abstract: In this talk, I will discuss mental representations and processes underlying our ability to comprehend and produce sentences. I will first talk about the importance of studying mental representations as well as processes. I will then give an overview of structural priming, a paradigm that has been extensively employed to tap into these representations and processes over the past three decades. On the basis of this, I will talk about studies that I have done on representations and processes respectively. On the representation side, I will review my research on verb-phrase ellipsis, missing arguments, and bilingual lexico-syntactic organizations. On the processing side, I will talk about my work on the mechanism by which a conceptual message is realized as a string of words. Finally, I will talk about semantic representation, an area that remains to be explored, and discuss how Chinese can be used to contribute to the study of language processing.
data.speakerBio: 蔡振光2010年在英国爱丁堡大学 (University of Edinburgh) 获得心理学博士学位,2011-2012年在英国曼彻斯特大学 (University of Manchester) 心理学院从事博士后研究,现为英国普利茅斯大学 (University of Plymouth) 心理学院专职科研人员。目前已在Journal of Memory and Language, Brain and Cognition等SSCI 国际重要期刊上发表多篇论文,为Bilingualism: Language and Cognition,Journal of Memory and Language,Language and Cognitive Processes 等国际重要学术刊物的审稿人。曾获爱丁堡大学研究生全额奖学金、英国实验心理学协会国外学习访问和会议资助等多项资助。

data.title: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.topic: 中文句子理解中语义信息的预视加工
data.speaker: 王穗苹
data.listTitle: （周四）下午4点到5点心理学学术沙龙
data.abstract: 自然阅读时对信息的处理并非始于中央凹的直接注视，而是从副中央凹的预视状态就开始。对预视效应进行研究，有助于从极早期的时间窗了解阅读理解中不同层次和不同维度信息处理的程度和机制。在本次沙龙中，我首先介绍如何通过眼动技术探讨阅读理解中的预视加工，并介绍我们近年所做的一些相关研究，目的是探讨在中文阅读中，高层的语义信息是否可以通过预视而得以加工以及语境限制性对这一过程的影响。

data.abstract: 预告: 何谓"心理"？心理有无形式("心理学")与内容("心里学")之分？心理的"计算乌云"能否驱散？"表征"概念是否为心理研究所必需？无"表征"支持的"心理"以何种形式存在？心理学是否为研究"心理现象"的唯一学科？心理学应从何角度研究"心理现象"？认知(或广义的心理)的"具身性"与认知神经科学研究目标的异同？"回归大脑"的研究路线对心理学而言,其研究价值何在？在第二代认知科学的视野下,如何划清"具身性"与"生理机制"("脑里学")的界限以及如何理解认知(心理)向环境的"延展"？心理研究与意识研究的关系如何？意识研究在整个心理学研究中居于于何种地位？心理学中科学主义和人文主义的缠斗与宿怨能否化解……
data.speakerBio: 李其维:华东师大心理与认知科学学院终身教授,华东师大校学术委员会委员,中国心理学会会士、副理事长,上海市心理学会理事长,《心理科学》主编,华东师大学报(教科版)副主编,瑞士日内瓦大学International Associate of Jean Piaget Archives Foundation。

data.topic: Transparent conducting oxides for thin film solar cells
data.speaker: 王洋
data.listTitle: 清洁能源团队讲座
data.abstract: Various aspects of the properties of transparent conducting oxides (TCOs) are reviewed in terms of how they impact the device performances of thin film solar cells. Of particular interest is light trapping effects due to different surface textures. Future directions are identified which may lead to further improvement in the TCO properties, as well as new concepts using plasmonics/metamaterial light trapping schemes as superior alternatives.
